ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_weighted_softplus
ir.intuition: Replaced the tanh link with a softplus-based margin loss on the advantage-weighted log probability difference to avoid similarity with existing tanh losses. Using softplus of negative margin encourages correct ranking with smooth gradients and bounded updates. This change ensures novelty while preserving pairwise advantage weighting and stable training.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
margin = beta * adv_gap * score_diff
loss = mean(weight * softplus(-margin))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.5)))
    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin = ops.mul(beta, ops.mul(adv_gap, score_diff))
    neg_margin = ops.neg(margin)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(weight, ops.softplus(neg_margin))
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
